Which statement about elements in Period 3 of the Periodic Table is correct?
A
Aluminium is a non-metal in Group III.
B
Argon is in Group VIII and has eight electrons in its outer electron shell.
C
Magnesium is in Group II and has three electrons in its outer electron shell.
D
Sulfur is a metal in Group VI.
